name: Aris V
description: Aris V was a planet in Parmel sector chosen as a possible base of operations for the Laramus Base Irregulars after they left Laramus Base.
lead_paragraphs: Aris V was a planet in Parmel sector chosen as a possible base of operations for the Laramus Base Irregulars after they left Laramus Base.
The Rebel Alliance struck an Imperial military target on Aris V before the Battle of Turak IV, leading to an increase in operations in the Parmel sector.
